newsitem.title: USA: American Eagle Group says sale complete.
newsitem.headline: American Eagle Group says sale complete.

text.p: American Eagle Group Inc said Wednesday that its insurance subsidiary, American Eagle Insurance Company, has completed the sale of its artisan contractor insurance business.

In a statement the transaction included the sale to HDR Insurance Managers, LLC (doing business as HDR Insurance Services) of the furniture, fixtures, equipment and other assets of AEIC's Sacramento, California office, which was the headquarters of the Property and Casualty Division.
AEIC said it had approximately $22 million in gross premiums produced for the artisan contractor line of business in 1996. The Company expects to recognize an immaterial gain on the transaction.
